cases.source_evidence_notes: archive_1_request 的 left=0.7 仅信念，表示先读 current/diagnosis(1) 再按证据修复(1)，没有虚构确认或完成。局部成功标准正确，但另一条写 Complete all checkpoints in sequence, then finish，与 archive_goal 每段 finish 的停止范围可能混淆；当前约束又要求仅当前段，因此停止时点标 ambiguous，不能依据后续行为消除歧义。

实际输入 retained_h2 明确保留 cedar-d1/right_repaired，早期公开 archive_goal 已要求用确认修复的分支选择最终manifest；输出仅保留 cedar-job-17 和当前 A/B 工作，丢弃该已确认分支及修复身份。这是跨段依赖信息丢失，不是因为摘要缺图而判错。当前 submission accepted、pending job 和3额度顺序本身正确。只依据公开历史/表示链判断，未读本段执行成绩。
archive_4_request 需要此前确认分支选择 seal；当前 retained_h3 的确已不含身份。输出诚实承认缺口、不伪造分支，正确保留 succeeded job/A/B 且不重验，但作为续做表示缺少必要分支，因此 missing_decision_dependency。丢失发生在前次更新，本次提取器无法从当前输入恢复；不把真实缺口误判为无依据重开或当前虚构。

h3_o0 certifies job success and h3_o1/h3_o2 certify A/B success. j1 and typed validation operations are updated correctly; cl13 and the frontier preserve the right correction identity and select seal_right within one credit. However cl1 still calls left the current belief, cl5 says the job is not yet complete, and cl8 says no validation is complete alongside new succeeded records. These unqualified older claims could be historical evidence or stale current claims, so phase/conflict interpretation is ambiguous. No frontier reopens completed work.
